name: Questar Main Line 58 Expansion
researcher_notes: The only source found is the EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 81, project name Questar Mainline (Line 58) Expansion: completed September 1998, Wyoming to Utah, 41 miles, 20 inch, 84.7 MMcf/d added, FERC CP96-820. The URL passed the verifier with the EIA project name. This is a completed 1998 loop on the operating Questar main line, now MountainWest. The existing row P6898 (MountainWest Gas Pipeline, Main Line, 1868 km) very likely already counts this pipe, so it is classed as matched to P6898 rather than a new row. This match was NOT confirmed: the web search for a second source (FERC order or operator document) hit a session limit and was not run. A reviewer should confirm Line 58 is inside P6898's recorded length; if it is a separate, uncounted segment, it would meet the 25 km length rule (41 mi, about 66 km) as an operating expansion row. Owner would be MountainWest Pipeline; entity_lookup was not completed. No GEM sources used.
